failures_and_deviations.description: Actual main was cf8b2faf18c52c6632e46bc1581fec5154849067 rather than expected 50cce6453644cac70fee629d6566ddc9504a0d71. The extra commit contained the authoritative charter rename and AGENTS.md. It was preserved and used as the base.

The Windows filesystem sandbox helper failed setup refresh for normal command execution and for the workspace apply_patch tool. The packet was copied byte-for-byte and later edits were applied with repository-local git apply from an approved WSL shell. A first combined git apply attempt failed atomically because README context omitted Markdown code ticks; the corrected patch then applied cleanly.
The first full pytest invocation could not import the src-layout package because it was not installed. No code was changed to mask the condition; the suite passed with PYTHONPATH=src.

The generic results directory ignore also matched coordination/results, so a narrow negation was added for committed relay handoffs. The byte-verbatim packet retains source CRLF endings; staged whitespace validation excludes that packet and verifies it separately with a byte comparison.

WSL Git lacked a credential helper, the connected GitHub integration returned HTTP 403 for PR creation, and the browser runtime was blocked by the Windows sandbox helper. The branch was pushed with host Git and PR #1 was created through the GitHub REST API using the existing Windows Git Credential Manager token only in process memory.
